model.name: Feature typed unit type + FeatureManager root-of-trust — product layer linking implementations to user grants
model.description: Tron model (2026-07-21, brief 0427d264f) + architect security design 83836631a (APPROVED rulings). ior:class:Feature is a first-class TYPED scenario unit = the PRODUCT layer: {name, description, icon, implementations[] (BOTH-WAY: Impl.feature back-ref, mirror-maintained), allowedUsers[] (-> profile TOKENS, BOTH-WAY with profile.features)}. Two instances: ServerManager (the R31.1-R31.4 feature) + FeatureManager (grant/revoke Features on profiles, root-of-trust). Generalizes R31.1 (profile renders granted-Feature list off m.features, server-computed) + R31.2 (access = requireFeatureAccess = isLiveSession AND user-in-Feature.allowedUsers, data-driven). SECURITY (architect-owned, finalized off 83836631a): FeatureManager grant-editing = HARDCODED owner-gate (root-of-trust, NOT data-driven = closes self-grant escalation); feature ACCESS = data-driven allowedUsers, AND-composed with isLiveSession; OWNER_TOKEN literal used ONLY for root-of-trust + bootstrap seed (==1 preserved, no literal-bypass into feature-access — owner enters via seeded membership); bootstrap idempotent-seeds OWNER_TOKEN into ServerManager+FeatureManager allowedUsers; INV-F5 empty/malformed allowedUsers FAILS CLOSED. Preserves R31.2 INV-G1/G2/G3 (grants only ADD checks). Route: req formalizes (this) -> expert implements (Feature units + Impl.feature back-refs + profile.features + requireFeatureAccess + FeatureManager grant/revoke owner-gated + bootstrap seed + m.features render) -> tester gates (both-way nav; grant/revoke flips member-200/non-member-403; profile lists granted; INV-F1..5 hold). TRON CLARIFICATION 2026-07-22 (capture-gate, architect-confirmed 83836631a, PO-approved): slice-(b+) MINT-GENERALIZATION — /session mint generalizes to 'any LIVE authenticated user mints a session carrying THEIR OWN token' (non-privileged binding); grant/revoke stays hardcoded-owner (root-of-trust); access = per-feature allowedUsers; INV-G re-verified under generalized mint (non-owner-WITH-session STILL 403 on ServerManager, gated by allowedUsers not session-absence). Without this, allowedUsers is inert (no non-owner could hold a session to be checked) — the Feature model wouldn't actually work for non-owners. +AC-mint-generalization. TRON CLARIFICATION 2026-07-22 (capture-gate, v0.7.107): FeatureManager RENDERS but does NOT OPEN on tap — the FeatureManager entry must OPEN into an admin VIEW (currently none). +AC-featuremanager-view: tap -> FeatureManager view in the DEFAULT DRAWER (consistent w/ ServerManager + R31.4 drawer DRY); lists each Feature + its allowedUsers; owner grants (by link-code/token) + revokes via the PROVEN grant/revoke API (POST /api/feature-manager, owner-gated); owner-only opens/uses (requireFeatureAccess). UC/Method for the view to be minted scenario-first from the architect's topology (design coordination requested, #126). TRON CLARIFICATION 2026-07-22 (capture-gate, IMG_4614): FeatureManager grant input = replace the raw player-token field with a USER SELECTOR + c2-style completion — type name/email/phone/uuid -> suggest matching user PROFILES (shown with identifying detail, see-the-profile) -> select -> Grant; multi-key resolve to the token via the existing phone/email alternate-UUID + profile data; owner-gated search+grant; same for revoke where useful. +AC-grant-user-selector. UC/Method (userSearch + selector) to be minted scenario-first from architect topology (design coordination requested, #126). TRON ADDENDUM 2026-07-22 (capture-gate, same AC): the matched-user DETAILED profile view REUSES the shared rb-detail-drawer (DRY, no new component) — selecting/expanding a suggestion opens the detailed profile IN the shared drawer, consistent with ServerManager/FeatureManager/trace detail-views. Folded into AC-grant-user-selector. TRON DRY REFRAME 2026-07-22 (capture-gate): the FeatureManager view = SHARED rb-trace-tree + rb-detail-drawer (like /server-manager), NOT a bespoke list. Features=items, granted-users=child-items; grant=add child-item (c2 selector), revoke=remove child-item, item-detail=shared drawer. SUPERSEDES the card-list. Folded into AC-featuremanager-view + AC-grant-user-selector. Chain reconciliation (architect R31.8c design, per-node topology on request): RETIRE/repoint mount b7d6ca6a (list superseded by tree), KEEP applyGrant ee4143df, RESHAPE listFeatures 5e338054 to itemView roots; NEW nodes = FeatureManager.searchUsers + RbFeatureManagerDetail.userComplete + RbProfileDetail.mount + a feature-detail; tagMap profile->rb-profile-detail (new) + feature->rb-feature-detail. TRON REFINEMENT 2026-07-22 (capture-gate, maximally-DRY): Features ARE typed scenario units (ior:class:Feature) — the FeatureManager tree renders them via the EXISTING scenario-unit itemView, NOT a reshaped API list. Feature unit=node, allowedUsers refs=child items; grant=add ref, revoke=remove ref, itemView re-renders from the unit. IMPLICATION for reconciliation (architect): listFeatures 5e338054 RESHAPE-to-itemView-roots may be SUPERSEDED (units render natively) rather than reshaped — flag to architect for the node-topology call. Folded into AC-featuremanager-view. SECURITY GAP 2026-07-22 (expert-discovered v0.7.112, bottom-up — not a Tron quote): the R31.8c native-render wired /api/trace/children to resolve Feature allowedUsers children (composite refs carrying the token) WITHOUT owner-gating -> member tokens leak to non-owners (violates INV-F1/masked-PII). +AC-trace-children-owner-gated: owner-gate /api/trace/children on Features + non-owner->403 + no token-bearing ref to non-owners; architect to decide the gating + whether the composite ref drops the raw token (userUuid instead). BLOCKS R31.8c functional-done until fixed+gated. TRON CAPTURE-GATE 2026-07-22: FeatureManager lists ALL enabled users (Feature.allowedUsers) as itemView CHILDREN of the feature, on load. Assessment (Rule 9): MOSTLY COVERED by AC-featuremanager-view (allowedUsers=children, complete, native itemView) + the uncapped allowedUsersChildren resolver (MEASURED: au.map over full allowedUsers, no slice/cap); SHARPENED with explicit +AC-featuremanager-lists-all-members to pin the on-load COMPLETENESS testably (N allowedUsers -> exactly N children on expand, no subset/cap) for the functional gate. Architect measurement coordinated (no cap in built impl). TRON DEVICE-FEEDBACK 2026-07-22 (capture-gate, IMG_4616 @390, R31.8c FUNCTIONAL confirmed working): "thats not bad, but it should be itemviews to the user scenario not additional uuids and in the details the users profile... the Revoke button is good - do the actions directly under the drawerbar and all further content below." 3 refinements captured: +AC-children-itemview-user-scenario (children = itemviews bound to user scenario, ref stays opaque per FIX-2, resolve server-side) + AC-detail-full-profile (drawer detail = full RbProfileDetail profile, not name+id+button) + AC-drawer-actions-layout (grab-bar->actions->content). Architect coordinates design/topology (itemview-bound resolution + RbProfileDetail full-render + actions-under-bar layout on shared rb-detail-drawer) before finalize. TRON/ARCHITECT 2026-07-22 (capture-gate): +AC-inv-f7-server-side-resolve — INV-F7: allowedUsersChildren + grantedUserProfile resolve userId->token->profile SERVER-SIDE; response carries ONLY masked display (name/avatar/masked-ids), NEVER raw token or secretCode; opaque FIX-2 ref preserved; GET /api/feature-manager/granted-user owner-gated (requireFeatureAccess Feature Manager); Revoke stays hardcoded-owner (INV-F4). + minted grantedUserProfile chain (UC featureManager.viewGrantedUser -> Method grantedUserProfile on FeatureManager 9f7f345a). TRON DEVICE-FEEDBACK ROUND 2 2026-07-23 (capture-gate): 'the real profile. good. ... full uuid not a truncated phone ... tree must update automatically ... latest on Refresh ... eager lazy ... collapsed still show correct children not 0 ... revoke directly under the drawer bar and then the full existing profileviewer ... reread the requirements i said. they included it already the first time.' HONEST GATE-GAP: round-1 AC-detail-full-profile + AC-drawer-actions-layout were captured but shipped as a name+truncated-phone STUB and the gate passed the WRONG surface (flow, not rendered @390) -> BOTH RE-OPENED status=reopened-unmet, do NOT re-close until built AND rendered-gated @390. +3 NEW ACs each pinned to a RENDERED @390 assertion: AC-item-description-full-uuid, AC-tree-auto-update-on-action, AC-collapsed-child-count-eager. Architect coordinates DRY reuse of the existing profile-viewer + the SHARED eager/lazy tree child-count mechanic (no fork). [[gate-the-ac-surface]] [[generic-behavior-in-the-shared-component]] PO ADD 2026-07-23: capture the impl approach on AC-detail-full-profile (delivered by EXTRACTING new shared RbProfileView — no reusable client viewer existed, hence round-1 stub; shared/masking-aware/INV-F7-by-construction) + new SCOPED FAST-FOLLOW AC-profile-single-viewer-fastfollow (migrate /profile to <rb-profile-view> = ONE viewer, not round-2-blocking but owned). TRON RULING 2026-07-23 (capture-gate, 10cf5cd3d) — AC-item-description-full-uuid RESOLVED: the granted-user item description = the OPAQUE userId (FIX-2 sha256(token)[:16]), NOT the raw token, NOT a separate profile-scenario uuid (Tron: it's the stable, non-sensitive, already-URL-addressable id; preserves INV-F7 by construction; safe under future non-owner delegation; display '<name> / <opaque-userId>'). This LIFTS the earlier HOLD on impl-edit (a) allowedUsersChildren desc=full-uuid (ad622052) — the form is now opaque userId sha256[:16]. ROUND-3 (architect design 0cd05131a, DELIVER LITERALLY) — Tron device-REJECTED round-2's masked/opaque surface (the scope-creep WE injected: sha256 uuid, masked mini-card, INV-F7-owner-masking, deferred /profile migration = the stub). Round-3 refines the ACs: subtitle = REAL profile/User-unit uuid (supersedes opaque sha256); drawer = REAL FULL data no-mask (supersedes masked subset); INV-F7 owner-masking WITHDRAWN (keep non-owner→403, the real P0); /profile MIGRATES NOW to <rb-profile-view> (drawer == /profile viewer = proof, ACTIVATES the ex-fast-follow); +AC-token-profileuuid-resolver (retires userIdOf-sha256/resolveGrantedToken/grantedAvatarUrl-opaque). The round-2 opaque + masked ACs are superseded IN PLACE with provenance (no silent overwrite). Tester gates @390 vs the /profile REFERENCE.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (2026-07-21): "model a scenario-first unit type Feature. it is referenced by all implementations. so ServerManager is a feature and itself references all implementations belonging to it… so both-way consistent navigation. additionally it references the user's scenarios that are allowed to use it from the user profile. a second feature on the same rights as the server manager is the FeatureManager, that allows to enable and disable features on user profiles. add a list of features to my profile this way where the server manager is currently."

discoverySource.flaggedBy: Tron (2026-07-21) via robbin-po (brief 0427d264f); security by robbin-architect (83836631a)
discoverySource.note: Feature typed unit + FeatureManager root-of-trust; security/bootstrap coordinated with architect per PO before finalizing ACs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ior:class:Feature is a first-class TYPED scenario unit (FeatureModel schema): name, description, icon, implementations[] (refs to Impl units), allowedUsers[] (refs to user profile TOKENS — profiles are Map+JSON today, server.ts:166; token is the stable identity; full profile-as-unit = later migration). The PRODUCT layer linking code to user grants.

INV-F-MIRROR: Feature.implementations[] <-> Impl.feature both-way — for every f in Feature.implementations, Impl(f).feature==Feature; Feature->its impls AND impl->its Feature both resolve. Mirror-maintained like Class.methods[]/Method.ownerIor; a drift-check fails loud.

Feature.allowedUsers[] <-> profile.features[] (new UserProfile field, Feature-uuid refs) both-way — a grant writes BOTH sides atomically, a revoke removes from BOTH. Feature->its users AND user->their features both resolve.

Two S31 Feature instances: ServerManager (implementations=[assertOwner impl 335dbf3d, attachPane 394eac63, readSessionTree 5c1701bc, renderFeatureGrants f345b8ed, buildSeedNode 5b3d9f1a, reapOrphans 5d313828 — representative, architect-refined]; allowedUsers=[Tron 41ad88c4]) + FeatureManager (function: enable/disable Features on profiles = grant/revoke; implementations to-be-built; allowedUsers=[Tron]).

REFRAMES R31.1: replace the single serverManager flag (server.ts:2625) with features:<Feature[] where token in allowedUsers> on the PROFILE ws msg (server-computed, same trust path, client can't self-grant). renderFeatureGrants iterates m.features -> one entry per granted Feature (name/icon/link) at #feature-grants. Tron -> [ServerManager, FeatureManager]; non-granted -> empty -> section ABSENT by construction (not UI-hidden).

REFRAMES R31.2 (architect design 83836631a): feature ACCESS = requireFeatureAccess(req, featureName) = isLiveSession(token) AND token in Feature.allowedUsers — data-driven membership, AND-composed (both fail-closed), replacing the hardcoded per-feature owner-gate. Added at the SAME server-side choke (server.ts:891 pattern), never bypassed; UI-hiding is NOT the gate. INV-F1: every feature's routes+ws -> 403 for non-members.

INV-F4 (root-of-trust): FeatureManager grant/revoke — ANY write to allowedUsers/profile.features — is gated by the HARDCODED owner-gate (ServerManagerGuard.assertOwner / the R31.2 OWNER_TOKEN literal), NOT data-driven. A data-driven-only path to grant-editing is the escalation HOLE (anyone reaching FeatureManager could self-add to any feature) and is REJECTED. Only the hardcoded owner mutates grants; a non-owner grant attempt -> 403, never mutates.

BOOTSTRAP + INV-F5: at first run an idempotent seed writes OWNER_TOKEN into ServerManager.allowedUsers AND FeatureManager.allowedUsers from the hardcoded literal (a generated seed step, R31.7-aligned) — the hardcoded owner is the bootstrap root, from there Tron grants others via FeatureManager; NO grant path exists that doesn't originate at the hardcoded owner. INV-F5: a feature with EMPTY/MALFORMED allowedUsers FAILS CLOSED (403 for all, incl owner-unless-seeded), NEVER fails-open.

R31.2 INV-G preserved, NOT weakened: INV-G1 stays ONE server-side choke (now calls requireFeatureAccess(feature), not requireOwnerHttp); INV-G2 the OWNER_TOKEN literal stays ==1 (used ONLY for the FeatureManager root-of-trust + bootstrap seed; feature access adds NO new literals, uses allowedUsers data; grep-guard still ==1); INV-F3 (=INV-G3) a feature ws upgrade checks requireFeatureAccess BEFORE handleUpgrade, non-member -> socket.destroy before open. The OWNER reaches ServerManager via seeded allowedUsers MEMBERSHIP (same data path as any grantee) — NO literal-bypass OR into feature-access.

The /session mint GENERALIZES: any LIVE authenticated user mints a session carrying THEIR OWN token (non-privileged binding — the session binds the caller's own identity, NOT an owner privilege). Grant/revoke stays HARDCODED-owner (root-of-trust, INV-F4); feature ACCESS = per-feature allowedUsers (requireFeatureAccess). INV-G RE-VERIFIED under the generalized mint: a non-owner WITH a live session is STILL 403 on ServerManager — gated by allowedUsers MEMBERSHIP, NOT by session-absence (the session existing does not grant access; allowedUsers does). This makes the Feature model actually WORK for non-owners (else allowedUsers is inert — no non-owner could ever hold a session to be membership-checked).

Tapping the FeatureManager entry in the profile Feature-access list OPENS the FeatureManager VIEW (v0.7.107 BUG: FeatureManager RENDERS in the list but does NOT open on tap — no view exists). The view MOUNTS in the DEFAULT DRAWER (consistent with ServerManager + the R31.4 drawer direction / the DRY shared detail-flow, NOT a bespoke overlay). The view LISTS each Feature + its granted users (allowedUsers). The OWNER grants a feature to a user (by link-code / token) AND revokes — backed by the PROVEN grant/revoke API (POST /api/feature-manager, owner-gated; the slice-(b) grantFeature/revokeFeature 5e2f6781/987a31a9). OWNER-ONLY opens/uses it (owner in FeatureManager.allowedUsers, enforced by requireFeatureAccess — NOT UI-hiding). ★ DRY TREE-VIEW REFRAME (Tron, supersedes the card-list): the FeatureManager view IS a TREE on the SHARED rb-trace-tree (like ServerManager otmux tree) — Features = ITEMS (root nodes), granted-users (allowedUsers) = CHILD ITEMS under each Feature node. Item-detail (feature node / user node) opens in the shared rb-detail-drawer. NO bespoke list/cards. The card-list framing above is SUPERSEDED. ★★ MAXIMALLY-DRY (Tron): the tree renders the Feature SCENARIO UNITS (ior:class:Feature) via the EXISTING scenario-unit itemView (NOT a reshaped API list) — the Feature UNIT is the node, its allowedUsers refs are the CHILD ITEMS; GRANT = ADD an allowedUsers ref to the unit, REVOKE = REMOVE the ref, and the itemView RE-RENDERS natively from the unit. Scenario units render themselves (same mechanism /trace uses) — no bespoke render, no API-list reshape.

The FeatureManager grant input is a USER SELECTOR with c2-style COMPLETION, replacing the raw 'player token to grant' field. Typing a name / email / phone / UUID completes/suggests matching USER PROFILES, each shown with identifying detail (SEE the profile, like c2 Tab-completion); selecting one -> Grant. MULTI-KEY resolve: name / email / phone / uuid -> the user token (leveraging the existing phone/email alternate-UUID + profile data). OWNER-GATED for BOTH search and grant (requireFeatureAccess / owner-gate; the search endpoint is owner-only, never leaks profiles to non-owners). Applies to the revoke side too where useful. PROFILE DETAIL REUSES THE SHARED DRAWER (DRY, no new component): selecting/expanding a matched user in the selector opens their DETAILED PROFILE in the shared rb-detail-drawer — consistent with the ServerManager / FeatureManager / trace detail-views (same shared detail-flow, not a bespoke popup). ★ TREE FRAMING (Tron): GRANT = ADD a user CHILD-ITEM under the Feature node (via the c2-completion user selector); REVOKE = REMOVE the child-item. The matched-user detailed profile opens in the shared rb-detail-drawer (tagMap profile->rb-profile-detail). Consistent with the shared item/itemView tree, no bespoke cards.

/api/trace/children on a Feature unit (it resolves allowedUsers via allowedUsersChildren, emitting COMPOSITE member refs that carry the user TOKEN) MUST be OWNER-GATED (INV-F): a non-owner GET -> 403, and token-bearing composite member refs are NEVER emitted to non-owners. ALSO evaluate whether the composite ref should carry the RAW TOKEN at all (token in a URL-addressable ref leaks via logs/history) — prefer a non-token composite (e.g. profile:<featureUuid>:<userUuid>) resolved server-side, per architect security design. Expert-discovered gap (v0.7.112): the native-render wired /api/trace/children to resolve Feature children WITHOUT owner-gating, leaking member tokens to non-owners — violates INV-F1 (owner-only) + masked-PII. The FUNCTIONAL tester gate MUST include this: non-owner /api/trace/children on a Feature -> 403, no token leak. ★ RESOLVED (architect 2919770c3, BOTH THIN no-new-node): (1) OWNER-GATE = thin wire of the EXISTING requireFeatureAccess (35e91ba7) into the /api/trace/children type===Feature branch (server.ts:1499) BEFORE returning children -> non-member/non-owner 403 (membership-gated Feature Manager, consistent w/ the view+GET; non-Feature units stay public). RELEASE-BLOCKER, gate FIRST. (2) DROP-RAW-TOKEN = impl-edit on allowedUsersChildren 72c660f9: composite ref = profile:<featureUuid>:<userId> (STABLE NON-TOKEN id), server resolves userId->token for display+revoke; the raw AUTH TOKEN NEVER rides a URL-addressable ref (defense-in-depth). Both impl-edits, expert wires. Functional gate asserts: non-owner /api/trace/children on a Feature -> 403 + no token in any emitted ref.

On expand/load of a Feature node in the FeatureManager tree, ALL of that Feature enabled users render as itemView CHILD nodes — a Feature with N allowedUsers shows EXACTLY N child user-nodes (COMPLETENESS: no subset, no cap/pagination-drop, no manual-refresh required). Resolved by allowedUsersChildren (72c660f9/Impl ad622052) which maps over the FULL Feature.allowedUsers (measured: no slice/cap in the built impl — unlike searchUsers which is capped-10, because MEMBERS are the authoritative set and must be complete), rendered NATIVELY via the existing itemView (CHAIN_TYPE_CONFIG Feature.scenarioFwd:[allowedUsers]). Owner-gated (AC-trace-children-owner-gated). Tester functional gate asserts N-in -> N-children on load at Tron viewport.

The granted-user CHILD nodes under a Feature are itemviews BOUND TO the user SCENARIO unit (the person profile), NOT standalone opaque-uuid rows (device IMG_4616: children were generic uuid rows, subtitle just repeated the name). The itemview resolves + navigates to the REAL user. ★ SECURITY (architect-owned, preserves FIX-2): the URL-addressable ref STAYS OPAQUE (<featureUuid>:<sha256(token)[:16]>, no raw token) — the itemview resolves the user SERVER-SIDE (owner-gated) for display/nav; do NOT re-expose the token to satisfy itemview-to-user-scenario. Display resolves the user; the ref stays hashed.

The FeatureManager drawer detail renders the FULL shared <rb-profile-view> with the granted user's REAL FULL data — real name, the User-unit uuid (id row), REAL phone/identifiers (NOT masked), REAL devices list (full details: type/deviceId/IP/screen/platform/connCount/lastSeen/online-dot), secret code, bug reports, real avatar. NO owner-side masking (round-3 WITHDRAWS it as scope-creep — Tron is sole owner/root-of-trust viewing real users on HIS console). Owner-gated (non-owner → 403, KEPT). RENDERED @390 == the /profile viewer surface. ROUND-3 SUPERSEDES the round-2 masked-subset render. Architect round-3 design 0cd05131a.

[RE-OPENED UNMET 2026-07-23 — Tron re-flags the layout] Order in the drawer body: [grab-bar (shared RbDetailDrawer chrome, untouched)] -> [Revoke button directly UNDER the grab-bar] -> [the FULL profile viewer BELOW it]. RENDERED @390 ASSERTION: in DOM order the Revoke control sits immediately under the grab-bar and the full profile viewer renders beneath it. Gate at the RENDERED surface @390, NOT 'flow works'. Do NOT re-close until built AND rendered-gated.

WITHDRAWN (round-3, 0cd05131a): INV-F7 owner-side MASKING (sha256 opaque userId, masked phone, opaque avatar route, no-secret/devices on the owner FM path) was OUR scope-creep, NOT a Tron requirement — Tron is sole owner /root-of-trust viewing REAL data on his own owner-gated console. The REAL protection is UNCHANGED and KEPT: non-owner → 403 on all Feature / /api/feature-manager / granted-user / Feature-branch-of-/api/trace/children endpoints (see AC-trace-children-owner-gated — the actual P0 fix). Keeping the raw token out of URL-addressable refs persists as a consequence of using the real profile uuid (item-1), not as re-added masking. FUTURE-ONLY flag: if FeatureManager is ever delegated to NON-owner admins, revisit raw token/secret/PII exposure — does NOT block round-3.

The granted-user child item's SUBTITLE (.oi-desc) == the user's REAL profile/User-unit uuid — resolve the allowedUsers token → its ior:class:User/Profile scenario unit → model.uuid (e.g. Marcel Donges = '37fcb752-8209-4ebe-b2e4-fd9e4a5b185d', DISTINCT from the token 41ad88c4…). NOT sha256/opaque, NOT a masked phone (+49..723), NOT the raw token. RENDERED @390. ROUND-3 (Tron device-rejected the round-2 masked/opaque surface) SUPERSEDES the round-2 opaque-userId form (was sha256[:16], a4628a3a7): the real profile uuid is the stable id; keeping the raw auth TOKEN out of URL-addressable refs is now a CONSEQUENCE of using the real uuid (not the credential), NOT re-added masking. Architect round-3 design 0cd05131a.

After granting or revoking a user's access, the tree view reflects it AUTOMATICALLY (the child appears / disappears, the parent feature's child-count updates); at the LATEST, pressing Refresh rebuilds it correctly. RENDERED @390 ASSERTION: grant -> the new child row is present + count incremented (auto, or after Refresh at worst); revoke -> the child row is gone + count decremented. Currently the tree does NOT update post-action = the defect.

A COLLAPSED feature node already shows its REAL granted-user child count in the badge (not 0), via the SHARED tree's eager-child-count + lazy-load mechanic (the generic itemView / rb-trace-tree behavior, solved once) — NOT a FeatureManager-specific reimplementation (do NOT re-fork tree behavior; it lives in the shared component). RENDERED @390 ASSERTION: with the feature collapsed, its count badge == the real number of allowedUsers (>0 when members exist), not 0. ROUND-3 impl path (unchanged intent): rb-trace-tree.ts:186 (PATH-B) passes root.childCount as serverChildCount to buildSeedNode (twin of the :186 expander fix); featureRoots already emits childCount. Expert 1-line, survives round-3 as-is. Tester bug ref 44e972e07.

ROUND-3 NOW (no longer a deferred fast-follow — the deferral caused the round-2 stub): /profile (server.ts:2254) MIGRATES to render via <rb-profile-view> fed the PROFILE ws msg m.profile (the viewer's own real profile incl token) → renders IDENTICAL to today's inline HTML = the PROOF <rb-profile-view> IS the real full viewer. The inline HTML layout MOVES into RbProfileView (data-driven, renders the fields present); feature-grants stays appended. RbProfileView is THE ONE full-profile viewer; /profile AND the FM drawer are its two callers. @390 GATE: the FM drawer renders the SAME viewer with real data; /profile still looks IDENTICAL (the reference). Architect round-3 design 0cd05131a.

A server resolver on FeatureManager maps an allowedUsers token <-> its ior:class:User/Profile scenario-unit uuid: profileUuidOf(token) (forward, for subtitle+ref+detail id-row) and tokenOfProfileUuid(uuid) (reverse, for the server to resolve a uuid-keyed ref back to the token to act, e.g. revoke). It REPLACES + RETIRES the round-2 scope-creep: userIdOf(sha256), resolveGrantedToken(sha256->token), grantedAvatarUrl(opaque) and the /api/feature-manager/granted-user/avatar opaque route, maskIdentifier/maskPhone on the owner FM path. Used by allowedUsersChildren (subtitle+ref), grantedUserProfile (id row + real data), and revoke (uuid->token). Architect round-3 design 0cd05131a.
